parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1: $9!/3!\times7=423360$ [M1 M1 A1]. Guidance: $9!/3!\times k$, $k$ integer $>0$, no $+$, $-$ or $\div$ [M1]; $7$ times an integer seen in final answer, no $+$, $-$ or $\div$ [M1]; exact value only [A1]. Alternative 1: ${9\choose3}7!(3!/3!)=423360$ [M1 M1 A1]. Guidance: ${9\choose3}k$ seen, $k$ integer $>0$, no $+$ or $-$ [M1]; $7!k$ seen, $k$ integer $>0$, no $+$ or $-$ [M1]; exact value only but there must be evidence of multiplying by $3!/3!$ [A1]. Alternative 2: $3(7)(8!/2!)=423360$ [M1 M1 A1]. Guidance: $3(8!/2!)k$ seen, $k$ integer $>0$, no $+$ or $-$ [M1]; $7$ times an integer seen in final answer, no $+$, $-$ or $\div$ [M1]; exact value only [A1]. Alternative 3: $7(2/11)(9/10)(8/9)(7/8)(1/7)\times$ total number of arrangements $=423360$ [M1 M1 A1]. Guidance: product of the correct five fractions times an integer $k>0$, no $+$ or $-$ [M1]; $7$ times 'total number of arrangements' times an integer $k>0$, no $+$ or $-$ [M1]; exact value only [A1]. Alternative 4: no E between Rs: ${6\choose3}3(7!)/3!=100800$; 1 E: ${6\choose2}3(7!)/2!=226800$; 2 Es: ${6\choose1}3(7!)=90720$; 3 Es: $7!=5040$ [M1 M1]. Guidance: find the correct number of ways for no, 1 or 2 Es between the Rs, accept unsimplified [M1]; add the number of ways for 3 or 4 correct scenarios [M1]. Total $=7(20+45+18+1)=7(84)=423360$ [A1], CAO. Total: 3.
